notes: Light of Promise, printed: 'Enchant creature. Enchanted creature has "Whenever you gain life, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature."' Cast onto your 2/2 host. You gain 3 life (Revitalize): the host gets 3 +1/+1 counters (5/5), your other creature none. On the opponent's turn the OPPONENT gains 3 life (their Revitalize): 'you' is the host's controller, so nothing more. Host ends with exactly 3 counters. Re-pinned 2026-10-30 (V2 + B-90 (a), at the cards/integration merge): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the mana is added at the step that spends it, standing in for the lands tapped there.
